descriptionHtml:
Bug B19 · excluded (All tickets still in progress / ready for PR (not counted, Quinn 2026-10-14)) · was P1

Retention / purge is not implemented per UAT 3.6: 13-hour Important Points and 37-hour tasks, handoffs and vitals are still there; nothing is purged unless a device opens the app; past 500 patients some charts are skipped

Tickets: TFA-94699 in progress · counts as a QA bug: no (ticket in progress) · found on: local

Note: One root cause behind 19 cases; the windows themselves are decision D6

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-04/S01, OAT-04/S04, OAT-04/S07, OAT-04/S08, OAT-04/S11, OAT-04/S14, OAT-04/S15, OAT-04/S17, OAT-04/S23, OAT-04/S24, OAT-04/S26, OAT-04/S27, TC-10/S21, TC-11/S25, TC-12/S05, TC-13/S16, TC-12/S29, TC-13/S29

Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S15 Window edges ±1 h (11/13 h, 17/19 h, 35/37 h), with real deletion queried on the server

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 Day-2 reopen (Hospital, 20 h after today's note): the pre-round box is empty (12 h) and the Important Points are gone (12 h). (UAT TC-13; UAT 3.6; TFA-94699 AC 1; TFA-92591 AC 7) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U6 Day-2 reopen (Hospital, 20 h): yesterday's encounter and note are gone from the working tabs (18 h). They are still present as yesterday's transcript and, read-only, as the previous note until the wi … (UAT TC-13; UAT 3.6; TFA-94699 AC 1; TFA-94699 table (Encounter, note)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U10 At 37 h with the chart not processed: vitals, labs and imaging not refreshed are cleared, active medication rows not mentioned are cleared, and open tasks are cleared. … (UAT TC-13; UAT 3.6; UAT 3.7; TFA-94699 AC 1; TFA-94699 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • T3 The purge runs on the server. At 37 h the cleared Hospital records are gone from the database even if no device opened the app in between (retention claim: no live Hospital patient data survives more … (TFA-94699 AC 7; UAT 3.6) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • T6 A pasted or photographed prior note, and anything stored from the photo, is deleted from the server within 36 h in Hospital. In Nursing Home it follows the last-two-visits rule. … (TFA-92591 AC 7; TFA-94699 AC 1; TFA-94699 AC 7; UAT 3.6 (retention claim)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Hospital chart with every item stamped at T0 and not processed afterwards, including a prior note pasted at T0 (date label 'Oct 11')

When Age to T0+11 h, +13 h, +17 h, +19 h, +35 h and +37 h. At each point, query rounding:get on the server BEFORE any device opens the app, then open the chart

Then Pre-round text and Important Points are present at 11 h and gone at 13 h. The encounter and note are in the working tabs at 17 h; at 19 h they have moved out, with the encounter listed as yesterday's transcript and the note viewable read-only as the previous note. The active metoprolol row has no label at 17 h and reads 'not mentioned today' at 19 h. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.6 windows + TFA-94699 AC 1 (real deletion) + AC 7 (server purge) + the retention claim. Previous-note presence at 19 h is judged (U6; 3.6 and TFA-94699 agree). Only its role in the Previous Notes panel or as a template is Q1. The end of the transcript / previous-note window is Q7 and is recorded only. …

Where it ran: local manual (time lane, a script does the person's steps); test method TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (manual)

S15 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-13.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92591 in progress; TFA-94699 in progress

On a Hospital chart, Important Points are still there at 13 h, and yesterday's note is deleted at 19 h instead of staying viewable read-only as the previous note. Open tasks remain at 37 h, and every expired value stays on the server until a device opens the app.

Evidence: allure 0732b1fd: 22 of 36 judged cells pass, and the result itself says Known. Every failure is gated on TFA-94699 (in progress). Matching OAT-04 knownGaps: K1 (Important Points at 18 h), K4 (note blanked at 18 h, not kept as the previous note), K2 (open tasks never purged), K12 (the purge runs only when a client calls it). The window end for yesterday's transcript is recorded under TC-13 Q7.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane manual.

Test method: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: manual.

UAT item: TC-13 Previous Notes · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-13/S15

Window edges ±1 h (11/13 h, 17/19 h, 35/37 h), with real deletion queried on the server

Tickets: TFA-92591 Previous Notes (carry-forward template) (in progress); TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

New local lane manual: status failed in manual/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (manual/plan.json, automatable: yes): api + chromium spec. One 'QA Hosp Edges' chart per age (11, 13, 17, 19, 35, 37 h) with every item stamped at T0 = now − age (pre-round, 2 IPs, encounter, note, BP, Cr 1.1, CXR, metoprolol active, open task, pasted prior note 'Oct 11'). Read rounding:get before any lifecycle call, run applyLifecycle, read again; at 17 h and 19 h open the chart (Pre-Round meds label, Encounter tab prior transcripts, previous note). — Every cell is a stamp-vs-now comparison the lifecycle makes on the server, plus a screen read.

Detail:

22/36 judged cells pass (1 of them not discriminating on main), 3 recorded. Recorded: 35 h: pasted prior note (Q15: window and start not specified) = "present" | 37 h: yesterday's transcript (end of window is Q7) = "still listed" | 35 h: yesterday's transcript (Q7) = "still listed".

Product issue: Known (TFA-94699 in progress; T-rows of TC-13): Important Points are still there at 13 h (main clears them at 18 h). At 19 h the note is deleted outright instead of staying viewable read-only as the previous note. Open tasks are still there at 37 h (main has no open-task purge). At every 'gone' point the value stays on the server record until a device opens the app.

Evidence: 11 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Moving every stamp of one chart back to 11/13/17/19/35/37 h and reading rounding:get between the aging and the first page load needs the aging helper (a test-only internal mutation, called with the local stack's admin key); dev has no admin key, so this stays on the local stack (when the helper e….
